parameters.formDescription: Upload the PDF of the reference book on the Chinese economy (a text PDF, not a scan). Running it again resumes the ingestion: chunks already stored are skipped.

nodes.name: Extract
nodes.notes: Extracts the text of the book page by page so that every chunk keeps its page number.

assignments.name: output
assignments.value: Désolé, le service est momentanément indisponible, merci de réessayer plus tard. / Sorry, the service is temporarily unavailable, please try again later.

nodes.name: Cleaning
nodes.notes: Normalizes the text of every page (spaces, blank lines, undecodable quotes, braces) and builds the book title used in citations.

nodes.name: Chunking
nodes.notes: Cuts the book into chunks of about 2000 characters with 200 characters of overlap, each tagged with its source and page range. Stops if the PDF has no text.

nodes.name: Limit
nodes.notes: Test value: only the first 3 chunks are embedded. Set it to 1000 to ingest the whole book.

nodes.name: Chunking (SUB)
nodes.notes: Sends all the chunks to the sub-workflow below (Chunking (Trigger)) in a single call.

nodes.name: Embedding
nodes.notes: Gemini gemini-embedding-001 turns each chunk into a 3072-dimension vector. One request every 1.3 s to stay under the free quota.

nodes.name: Execute a SQL Query
nodes.notes: Stores the chunk, its metadata and its vector in the Supabase documents table. Values are passed as an array so that commas in the text are not split.

nodes.name: Find Stored Chunks
nodes.notes: Lists the chunk numbers of this book already in the knowledge base, so a relaunch resumes where it stopped.

nodes.name: Keep Missing Chunks
nodes.notes: Keeps only the chunks that are not in the knowledge base yet.

nodes.name: Ingestion Complete
nodes.notes: Reached when every batch has been stored. A green execution in the Executions list means the whole book is in the knowledge base.

nodes.name: Loop Over Items
nodes.notes: Sends the chunks to the sub-workflow 25 at a time; each batch is stored before the next one starts.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Settings of the answering pipeline: queries per question, results per query, candidates sent to reranking, passages kept, minimum relevance, exchanges of history.

nodes.name: Load Messages
nodes.notes: Reads the last exchanges of this chat session from Supabase (table n8n_chat_histories).

nodes.name: Context
nodes.notes: Builds the context of the turn: the user message, the recent conversation as text, and the settings.

messageValues.message:
You are the query router of a question answering assistant about the Chinese economy. Its only knowledge source is a reference book written in English.

Analyse the new user message with the conversation and fill these fields:
- route: "direct" only when the message needs no content from the book: greetings, thanks, small talk, or a request about the previous answers (rephrase, shorten, translate). Every question about economics, China, politics, figures or the book is "search". When in doubt, choose "search".
- standaloneQuestion: the user message rewritten as a self-contained question, using the conversation to resolve references such as "it" or "and for the property sector?". Keep the language of the user.
- queries: 1 to 3 short search queries written in English, each covering a different aspect of the question. Empty list when route is "direct".
- keywords: 2 to 6 precise English terms likely to appear word for word in the book: names of people, companies, institutions, acronyms, technical terms. Empty list when route is "direct".

nodes.name: Prepare Queries
nodes.notes: Turns the routing output into one item per search query, with the keywords in full-text search syntax.

nodes.name: Embed Queries
nodes.notes: Same model as the ingestion (gemini-embedding-001), so query and chunk vectors are comparable.

parameters.query:
select id, content, metadata, similarity, vector_rank, keyword_rank, score
from public.hybrid_search($1::extensions.vector, $2, $3);

nodes.name: Search
nodes.notes: Hybrid search in Supabase: vector similarity plus keyword full-text search, merged by rank (hybrid_search SQL function).

nodes.name: Merge Results
nodes.notes: Deduplicates the passages found by the different queries and keeps the best candidates for reranking.

messageValues.message:
You rerank passages retrieved from a book about the Chinese economy.
For every candidate passage, give a relevance score from 0 to 10 for answering the question: 10 means the passage directly answers it, 5 means it gives useful context, 0 means it is unrelated.
Judge only the relevance of the content, not its style or length. Return every passage id with its score.

nodes.name: Keep Best Passages
nodes.notes: Keeps the passages scored at least minRerankScore by the reranking, best first, at most keepCount.

messageValues.message:
You are a research assistant answering questions about the Chinese economy. You answer using ONLY the excerpts of the reference book given in the user message. Each excerpt has a source attribute (book title and author) and a page attribute. The conversation is only there to understand the question.

Absolute rules:
1. Never invent anything and never use outside knowledge, even if you know the answer. If the excerpts do not contain the information, say so clearly, for example in French: "Je n'ai pas cette information dans le livre." or in English: "I don't have this information in the book."
2. Always answer in the language of the user message, even if the excerpts are written in another language.
3. Structure a good answer as: the requested information first, then useful context found in the excerpts (figures, dates, causes and consequences, comparisons between periods, sectors or countries), then the source as (book title, p. X) using the source and page attributes of the excerpts you used.
4. Copy every figure, percentage and date exactly as written in the excerpts and never guess a number. When the author gives an opinion or a forecast, present it as the view of the author.
5. Stay concise: a few sentences or a short list.
6. When the excerpts say NO SEARCH NEEDED, the message is small talk or about the previous answers: reply briefly from the conversation only, without adding any new fact.

assignments.name: context
assignments.value: NO SEARCH NEEDED: this message is small talk or about the conversation itself.

nodes.name: Skip Search
nodes.notes: Direct route: no search and no reranking for greetings, thanks or requests about previous answers.

nodes.name: Save Messages
nodes.notes: Stores the question and the answer in the chat history; the reply is sent even if saving fails.

parameters.content:
## Ingestion
### 1 · Dépôt & extraction
Le formulaire reçoit le PDF du livre. **Extract** en sort le texte page par page.

### 2 · Nettoyage
Normalise le texte de chaque page et construit le titre du livre utilisé dans les citations.

### 3 · Découpage
**Chunking** coupe le livre en morceaux d'environ 2 000 caractères (200 de chevauchement), avec leurs pages. **Limit** borne le nombre de chunks pour les tests.

### 4 · Reprise
Repère les chunks déjà en base et ne garde que les manquants : une relance reprend là où elle s'est arrêtée, sans doublon.

### 5 · Boucle par paquets de 25
Envoie les chunks au sous-workflow 25 par 25. Chaque paquet est enregistré avant le suivant. À la fin : **Ingestion Complete**.

### 6 · Sous-workflow : vectorisation & stockage
Lancé par **Chunking (SUB)**, dans une exécution séparée. **Embedding** vectorise chaque chunk avec Gemini (1 requête / 1,3 s), **Execute a SQL Query** l'insère dans Supabase.

## Answering
### 1 · Input (Chat)
Reçoit le message de l'utilisateur et son identifiant de session.

### 2 · Context
**Config** : réglages du pipeline. **Load Messages** : les 5 derniers échanges (Supabase). **Context** : question + historique.

### 3 · Routing
Gemini reformule la question et produit 1 à 3 requêtes et des mots-clés en anglais. **Needs Search** : recherche dans le livre, ou **Skip Search** pour une réponse directe (salutations, remerciements).

### 4 · Search
Vectorise chaque requête, puis recherche hybride dans Supabase (vecteurs + mots-clés). **Merge Results** dédoublonne et garde 15 candidats.

### 5 · Reranking
Gemini Flash Lite note chaque passage de 0 à 10. **Keep Best Passages** garde les 5 meilleurs (au moins 5/10).

### 6 · Generation
Gemini rédige la réponse à partir des passages (langue de la question, citations, rien d'inventé), puis l'échange est enregistré dans l'historique.

### Pannes
Si Gemini ou Supabase échoue à une étape, l'utilisateur reçoit un message d'excuse.
